name: Slack approval and delivery queue (production template)

nodes.name: Slack approval callback
nodes.notes: Set Slack Interactivity to this production webhook. It acknowledges immediately; delivery is asynchronous and durable.

nodes.name: Verify signature and parse review decision
nodes.notes: Requires SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET only as a server-side n8n environment variable and Node built-in crypto access.

nodes.name: Validate workspace and triage channel
nodes.notes: Replace both IDs after import. This prevents a signed button from another workspace or channel being accepted.

nodes.name: Record authorized decision and queue delivery
nodes.notes: One database transaction validates the approver, locks the draft and cluster, records the decision, and queues idempotent delivery attempts.

nodes.name: Build finalized Slack card
nodes.notes: Removes action blocks only after an accepted or already-processed decision. Denied or tampered actions leave the card available to an authorized reviewer.

nodes.name: Disable reviewed Slack card
nodes.notes: Attach the existing Slack API credential. chat.update removes buttons from only the reviewed message timestamp.

parameters.jsCode: if($json.ok!==true)throw new Error(`Slack card update rejected: ${$json.error??'unknown error'}`);return[{json:$('Build finalized Slack card').item.json}];

nodes.name: Run queued delivery worker
nodes.notes: Select the imported report-delivery workflow. The worker claims one durable stage at a time and may be safely re-run.

nodes.name: Record authorized investigation action
nodes.notes: Validates the same approver and Slack context as report approval. Investigation actions never enqueue engineering delivery.

parameters.jsCode: const allowed=new Set(['retry_queued','dismissed','split','ignored_not_open','duplicate_callback']);if(!allowed.has($json.action_status))return[];const labels={retry_queued:'Retry requested',dismissed:'Dismissed',split:'Split requested',ignored_not_open:'Already processed',duplicate_callback:'Already processed'},icons={retry_queued:'🔄',dismissed:'🗑️',split:'🔀',ignored_not_open:'ℹ️',duplicate_callback:'ℹ️'},blocks=($json.message_blocks??[]).filter(block=>block.type!=='actions');blocks.push({type:'context',elements:[{type:'mrkdwn',text:`${icons[$json.action_status]} *${labels[$json.action_status]}* by <@${$json.actor_id}>`} ]});return[{json:{...$json,slack_body:{channel:$json.channel_id,ts:$json.message_ts,text:`Root-cause investigation — ${labels[$json.action_status]}`,blocks}}}];

nodes.notes: Attach the existing Slack API credential.

nodes.notes: Select the imported cluster-review workflow. The existing cluster_id is passed through without creating a ticket.
